text: A glint under the surface, just out of reach. {lead} hooks it with patience and a bit of reed. It is Ammonite.
A wall with a tooth missing. {lead} rebuilds it with no mortar and a great deal of dignity, and finds Rowan Sprig in the hollow.
The old trunk is hollow and ready to go. {lead} heaves, it topples, and out of the hollow rolls Hazelnuts.
Soft ground, a patient creature, and a lot of worms. {lead} brings up the lot, and under them: Four-Leaf Clover.
{lead} paddles you across in the little round boat, spinning once for good manners. The far bank is quiet, reedy and yours.
{lead} paddles you back. The boat drifts in a gentle circle the whole way, and nobody mentions it.
Soft ground, a patient creature, and a lot of worms. {lead} brings up the lot, and under them: Stick of Rock.
